WITH MTDADB AS(
SELECT
    ---TOP 100 
    FADBMTD.BusinessDateSK
    ,DC.CustomerSK
    ,DC.CustomerID
    ,DCA.AccountSK
    ,DCA.AccountID
    ,FADBMTD.AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDProrated
    FROM DW.DimCustomer DC
    LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount DCA ON DC.CustomerSK = DCA.CustomerSK
    LEFT JOIN DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceMTD FADBMTD ON DCA.AccountSK = FADBMTD.AccountSK
    LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DA ON DCA.AccountSK = DA.AccountSK
    WHERE DA.AccountStatus != 'Closed'
)
, YTDADB AS(
SELECT
    ---TOP 100 
    FADBYTD.BusinessDateSK
    ,DC.CustomerSK
    ,DC.CustomerID
    ,DCA.AccountSK
    ,DCA.AccountID
    ,FADBYTD.AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDProrated
    FROM DW.DimCustomer DC
    LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount DCA ON DC.CustomerSK = DCA.CustomerSK
    LEFT JOIN DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceYTD FADBYTD ON DCA.AccountSK = FADBYTD.AccountSK
    LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DA ON DCA.AccountSK = DA.AccountSK
    WHERE DA.AccountStatus != 'Closed'
)
, DepositsOutstandingBalance AS (
SELECT
    ---TOP 100 
    FDOB.BusinessDateSK
    ,DC.CustomerSK
    ,DC.CustomerID
    ,DCA.AccountSK
    ,DCA.AccountID
    ,FDOB.BalanceAmountProrated
    FROM DW.DimCustomer DC
    LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount DCA ON DC.CustomerSK = DCA.CustomerSK
    LEFT JOIN DW.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance FDOB ON DCA.AccountSK = FDOB.AccountSK
    LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DA ON DCA.AccountSK = DA.AccountSK
    WHERE DA.AccountStatus != 'Closed'
)
SELECT
    TOP 100
    C.BusinessDateSK
    ,A.CustomerSK
    ,A.CustomerID
    ,A.GlobalCIF
    ,A.BankSK
    ,SUM(B.AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDProrated)
    ,SUM(C.AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDProrated)
    ,SUM(D.BalanceAmountProrated)
    FROM DW.DimCustomer A
    LEFT JOIN MTDADB B ON A.CustomerSK = B.CustomerSK
    LEFT JOIN YTDADB C ON A.CustomerSK = C.CustomerSK
    LEFT JOIN DepositsOutstandingBalance D ON A.CustomerSK = D.CustomerSK
    GROUP BY C.BusinessDateSK, A.CustomerSK, A.CustomerID, A.GlobalCIF, A.BankSK
    ORDER BY C.BusinessDateSK, A.CustomerID
